summary: Every-5-minute cron does KV, D1, Workers AI, R2 and Queue work for every user.

expected_findings.contains: const { results: users } = await env.DB.prepare("SELECT id, email FROM users").all<User>();
expected_findings.explanation: The cron runs 288 times a day and, for every user with no LIMIT or batching, reads KV, scans that user's full activity history in D1, runs an AI summary over all of it, writes a new R2 object, inserts a D1 row and enqueues an email. Cost grows with users x history x 288 per day, with no change detection, and Promise.all fans out every user at once.
